app_type: Mobile-First Field Service Operational SaaS Dashboard
target_audience: Field mechanics, mobile automotive technicians, automotive service managers & administrators in Mexico
design_philosophy: Industrial Luxury & High-Tactile Tactical Precision. Dark obsidian & metallic champagne gold palette engineered for heavy field usage, outdoor sunlight legibility, and effortless one-handed smartphone control.

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight
scale.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide
scale.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 font-mono

layout.mobile: Single column vertical stack, bottom persistent tactical navigation bar with large 48px touch targets, sticky compact header with session badge and ES/EN toggle.
layout.desktop: Collapsible left sidebar with golden industrial accents + fixed top header + multi-column grid for KPIs and module widgets.

responsive.tap_targets: Minimum touch height 48px to 56px for inputs and main CTAs to allow effortless single-handed operation with or without work gloves.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root containers, horizontal scrolling tables wrapped in responsive containers with touch momentum.

login_screen.structure: Full-height obsidian container (`bg-[#070707]`) with subtle dark geometric mesh overlay, centered responsive card (`max-w-md w-full p-6 sm:p-8 bg-[#101010] border border-[#262626] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl`).
login_screen.branding: Metallic gold emblem/logo badge, 'ARMENTA'S MOTORS' wordmark, 'ARMENTA OS' subtitle with glowing operational status indicator.
form_elements: Contraseña field (Icon + Input + Show/Hide toggle, h-12)
ENTRAR button (h-14, solid #C9A45C text-black font-bold text-lg hover:bg-[#D9B46A] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(201,164,92,0.25)])
Loading indicator state with metallic spinner and 'Verificando credenciales...' text
Error feedback toast/alert box in crisp dark red (`#451A1A`) with border `#EF4444`
Quick credentials demo helper button for instant field testing

header.title: ARMENTA OS
header.subtitle: CONTROL OPERATIVO DE CAMPO
elements: Session Badge: '● SESIÓN ACTIVA' with pulse effect in emerald green
Logout button ('Cerrar Sesión' / 'Log Out') with confirmation modal

quick_actions_and_status.action_panel: Field Operations Quick Bar: 'Iniciar Nuevo Servicio', 'Registrar Vehículo', 'Crear Cotización' (each opening future phase modal or triggering 'Próximamente' feedback)
quick_actions_and_status.recent_activity: Tactical timeline preview showing real-time mobile unit dispatch readiness in Mexico.

future_modules_placeholder.display: Clean high-end industrial placeholder layout when navigating to non-CONTROL tabs.
elements: Module Title (CLIENTES, VEHÍCULOS, SERVICIOS, COTIZACIONES, COBROS, FINANZAS, TÉCNICOS, EMPRESAS, CONFIGURACIÓN)
Detailed preview card of upcoming capabilities (e.g. for VEHÍCULOS: VIN Scanner, Historial de Mantenimiento, Registro de Placas México)
Button: 'Volver a Control' / 'Back to Control Panel'

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626 on dark surfaces, with gold accent stroke (`#C9A45C33`) on focused or active cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient black shadow (`shadow-xl`) + localized gold glow for high-priority CTA actions (`drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(201,164,92,0.2)]`).
visual_enhancers.textures: Carbon fiber inspired micro-dot pattern or clean matte obsidian finish.
visual_enhancers.one_handed_mode: Key interactive controls placed within thumb reach zone on mobile screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code files are .js or .jsx format (not .tsx).
Build a robust authentication state management system (React Context or state hook with localStorage persistence) holding current user info, session active state, and current locale ('es' or 'en').

Implement the Login Screen with real-time field validation, error state simulation (e.g., incorrect password feedback), loading state on submit, and a handy 'Cargar Demo' button to prefill 'admin' / 'armenta2026' or 'tecnico' / 'campo2026'.
Implement the CONTROL Dashboard with full bilingual support (Spanish/English translations for all labels, cards, badges, and tooltips).
Render the 4 mandatory KPI Cards: Servicios Hoy (0), Cotizaciones (0), Por Cobrar ($0), and Estado (OPERATIVO).
Build full responsive navigation with a Mobile Bottom Bar for smartphones and a Collapsible Sidebar for tablets/desktop.

Provide clear 'Próximamente' / 'Coming Soon' placeholder pages with feature previews when clicking non-Control navigation tabs (Clientes, Vehículos, Servicios, Cotizaciones, Cobros, Finanzas, Técnicos, Empresas, Configuración).
Apply strict `data-testid` attributes to all form inputs, buttons, badges, KPI cards, navigation items, and header actions as specified in `data_testids`.
Use Lucide-React icons (`lucide-react`) for clean industrial UI iconography (Wrench, ShieldCheck, DollarSign, FileText, Car, Users, Settings, LogOut, Globe, CheckCircle).
Use `sonner` for toast notifications when performing actions like toggling language, logging out, or clicking quick action buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark obsidian colors look best when used clean without bright colorful rainbow gradients.
Do not use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML inputs.
Ensure input fields have high contrast text (#FFFFFF) and explicit hover/focus states with gold borders (#C9A45C).
Never rely on transparent dropdowns or header backgrounds that make content illegible when scrolling.
Always set high-contrast text explicitly on hover states: e.g. `hover:bg-[#18181B] hover:text-white`.
Touch targets on mobile must be at least 48px height with generous padding for gloved or single-handed field usage.
